title: pop: independently analyze the request without the opposite auction side

source.name: ortbtools Core pop-family ext-hint recognition contract (packages/core/non-iab-formats.js STRING_HINT_KEYS, packages/core/rules/pop-request/index.js, packages/core/rules/pop-response/index.js) layered on IAB OpenRTB 2.x Imp/ext extensibility — the product's own documented, in-repo mechanism for pop/clickunder signalling, not a named vendor's wire format
source.version: repo HEAD at session start, commit a61fc25
source.license: Internal product code (ortbtools); no third-party material copied. MIT for the original fixture values.
source.notes: This case exercises the plain `iab` dialect plus Core's baseline non-IAB format scanner, deliberately without loading the `ext-rtb` vendor dialect — the pop-request/pop-response rule plugins and non-iab-formats.js hint scanner run unconditionally regardless of dialect selection.

modifications: All IDs, domains, prices and timestamps independently authored.
device.ip uses TEST-NET 192.0.2.44; user.id is a clearly synthetic string.
advertiser.example.test / tracking.example.test / publisher.example.test are reserved .test hosts; no live host, tracker or subscriber identifier.
Remove the response from pop-x-openrtb-adtype-popunder-window-open; no auction relation may be invented from an absent side.
provenance.sanitized: No real visitor or subscriber data. IP 192.0.2.44 is TEST-NET-1; every identifier is a synthetic-fixture string; every URL uses a reserved .test hostname.

pairApplicability.note: The opposite auction side is deliberately absent; validation remains meaningful and crosscheck must be empty.

device.ua: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

specNotes: The Inspector/API accept either auction side independently. Apply validation to the submitted side and do not manufacture auction matches, floors or required-asset comparisons from the absent side.
Preview expectation is retained only for a submitted response. The body and public-source provenance come from pop-x-openrtb-adtype-popunder-window-open.
notes: This is the plain `iab` dialect, not the `ext-rtb` vendor dialect used by the sibling EXADS/Kadam/PPCmate/Adon3 pop cases — the mechanism under test (non-iab-formats.js hint scanning, pop-request/pop-response plugins, the 3d-pop crosscheck rule) runs unconditionally regardless of which dialect is loaded.
